forecasts.question: Will AGI be developed before 1 January 2030?
forecasts.key_change: Stable; Metaculus community at ~25% by 2029, technical barriers persist despite bullish industry claims

factors_up.factor: Industry CEOs (Altman, Hassabis, Schmidt) predict AGI within 3-5 years
Rapid capability gains in reasoning and coding benchmarks

factors_down.factor: Five key technical barriers remain (persistent memory, world models, robust reasoning, data scaling, evaluation)
Definition disagreement - strict definitions require robotics capabilities that lag
Only ~3.7 years remaining on clock

key_uncertainties: Whether current scaling paradigm hits diminishing returns
Whether novel architectures emerge that bypass current limitations

update_triggers.up: Major breakthrough in reasoning or world models; credible lab announces AGI-adjacent system
update_triggers.down: Evidence of scaling plateaus; major lab pivots strategy away from AGI pursuit

forecasts.question: Will economic consultancy lose ≥33% value/jobs by end 2030 due to AI?
forecasts.key_change: Stable; McKinsey revenue flat at $15-16B but AI revenue growing 120% YoY; industry restructuring not collapsing
forecasts.base_rate: No historical precedent for industry declining 33% in 6 years from tech disruption

factors_up.factor: McKinsey cutting non-client-facing staff; entry-level roles most disrupted
AI tools increasingly capable of analysis and slide creation

factors_down.factor: Consulting firms actively monetising AI (40% of McKinsey work is AI-related)
Revenue remains flat, not declining; firms hiring AI specialists
Client demand for AI strategy consulting creating new revenue streams

key_uncertainties: Whether AI commoditises analysis fast enough to erode premium pricing
Whether consulting firms can pivot to AI implementation services

update_triggers.up: Major firm reports revenue decline >10%; mass redundancies across Big 4
update_triggers.down: Consulting revenue growth resumes; AI creates net new consulting categories

forecasts.question: Will Labour be largest party at next UK General Election?
forecasts.key_change: Slight decline; April Electoral Calculus now shows Labour at just 63 seats vs Reform 266; Labour polling at 19%
forecasts.base_rate: Labour won 411 seats in 2024; current polls show collapse to 63 seats

factors_up.factor: Election is still up to 3 years away; polls can shift significantly
Reform may struggle with local organisation and candidate quality

factors_down.factor: Labour at 19% in polls, behind Reform (26%) and barely ahead of Conservatives (18%)
Electoral Calculus projects just 63 seats for Labour, massive seat losses
Government approval at historic lows; combined Lab+Con vote share at record low 37%
Green Party gaining on Labour's left flank

key_uncertainties: Whether Reform can maintain support through to election day
Whether a Labour leadership change could reset polling

update_triggers.up: Labour recovers to >25% in polls; Reform suffers scandal or internal split
update_triggers.down: Labour falls below 15%; Reform establishes ground-level infrastructure

forecasts.question: Will AGI be developed before 1 January 2035?
forecasts.key_change: Stable; Metaculus median AGI date ~2033 with 50% probability; expert consensus shifting earlier
forecasts.base_rate: Metaculus: 50% by 2033; AI researcher surveys: median mid-century but shifting

factors_up.factor: Metaculus community median now at 2033, within this window
Massive capital investment ($100B+) accelerating research
Nearly 9 years remaining - substantial runway

factors_down.factor: Technical barriers may require fundamentally new approaches
Regulatory headwinds could slow deployment and testing

key_uncertainties: Whether current paradigm scales to AGI or requires new breakthroughs
Whether geopolitical disruption slows AI investment

update_triggers.up: Systems pass increasingly stringent AGI benchmarks; new architectural breakthroughs
update_triggers.down: Scaling laws flatten; major labs report diminishing returns on compute investment

forecasts.question: Will China initiate a military blockade or invasion of Taiwan before 1 January 2030?
forecasts.key_change: Stable; US intelligence says imminent attack unlikely; PLA logistics gaps persist despite high military activity
forecasts.base_rate: No full military blockade or invasion by PRC since 1949; grey zone activity frequent but sub-threshold

factors_up.factor: Record military activity: 100+ aircraft in single day (Dec 2025); rockets landing in contiguous zone
PRC disinformation narrative focusing on Taiwan's blockade vulnerability
Blockade strategy may be seen as lower-cost than invasion

factors_down.factor: US intelligence assesses imminent attack unlikely; Beijing prefers unification without force
Amphibious assault extremely difficult with high failure risk, especially with US intervention
Economic cost estimated at $2-10 trillion; 20% GDP from exports at risk
PLA logistics and training gaps assessed to persist until 2027-2030

key_uncertainties: Whether a political crisis (e.g., Taiwan independence declaration) could trigger action
Whether US deterrence posture changes significantly

update_triggers.up: Major military buildup beyond exercises; blockade-enabling infrastructure deployment
update_triggers.down: Cross-strait diplomatic engagement; PRC economic crisis reduces risk appetite

forecasts.question: Will UK annual CPI inflation fall below 2.0% for at least one month before 1 January 2027?
forecasts.key_change: Slight downward pressure; BoE now forecasts CPI 3-3.5% in Q2-Q3 2026 due to Middle East energy shock; earlier NIESR forecast of sub-2% in April now overtaken
forecasts.base_rate: CPI at 3.0% in Feb 2026; BoE revised up to 3-3.5% for Q2-Q3 2026

factors_up.factor: NIESR had forecast sub-2% by April before Middle East shock
Base effects from prior energy price spikes could create brief dip

factors_down.factor: BoE now forecasts 3-3.5% through summer 2026 due to energy prices
Only 9 months remaining; CPI needs to drop 1+ percentage points
Middle East conflict creating sustained upward pressure on energy costs

key_uncertainties: Whether Middle East conflict resolves quickly, allowing energy prices to normalise
Whether Q4 2026 base effects create a brief sub-2% reading

update_triggers.up: Sudden energy price collapse; Middle East ceasefire
update_triggers.down: Further energy price spikes; services inflation remains sticky

forecasts.question: Will Spider-Man: Brand New Day gross over $1.5B worldwide by 31 December 2026?
forecasts.key_change: Stable; trailer hit 1 billion views (first ever); projections at $2.3-2.5B worldwide; release July 31
forecasts.base_rate: No Way Home grossed $1.9B; multiverse/crossover Spider-Man films consistently perform above $1.5B

factors_up.factor: Trailer broke all records: 718M views in 24 hours, now 1B+ total
Projections from analysts at $2.3-2.5B worldwide
Strong MCU brand momentum with Avengers: Doomsday in same year

factors_down.factor: Film hasn't released yet (July 31) - production/quality risks remain
Geopolitical or pandemic disruption could affect theatrical release
Superhero fatigue narrative persists, though Spider-Man seems immune

key_uncertainties: Whether the film's quality matches hype
Whether summer box office conditions are favourable

update_triggers.up: Early reviews are overwhelmingly positive; opening weekend exceeds $300M domestic
update_triggers.down: Negative reviews; production delays; major competing release

forecasts.question: Will OpenAI and Anthropic have a combined ARR exceeding $70B by 31 December 2026?
forecasts.key_change: Up from 72%; Anthropic reportedly at $30B ARR (April), OpenAI at $25B (March); combined ~$55B with 8 months to go
forecasts.base_rate: Combined ARR ~$55B as of March-April 2026; need $15B more by year-end

factors_up.factor: Anthropic ARR growth ~10x/year; grew from $14B (Feb) to $30B (Apr) in 2 months
OpenAI growing ~3.4x/year; strong enterprise and consumer demand
Both companies releasing increasingly capable models driving adoption

factors_down.factor: Anthropic may report gross revenue through cloud channels (inflated vs. net)
Growth rates may decelerate as base gets larger
Enterprise adoption cycles may slow in H2 2026

key_uncertainties: Whether Anthropic's reported ARR figures are comparable to OpenAI's methodology
Whether growth rates can sustain through year-end

update_triggers.up: Credible Q2/Q3 revenue reports showing continued acceleration
update_triggers.down: Revenue methodology clarification showing lower net figures; growth deceleration

forecasts.question: Will UK average annual real GDP growth exceed 1.5% across the 2030s (2030-2039)?
forecasts.key_change: Slight decline; OBR March 2026 lowered TFP growth to 0.8% from 1.1%; trade policy risks elevated
forecasts.base_rate: OBR forecasts average 1.5% growth from 2027 onwards; UK averaged ~1.4% in 2010s

factors_up.factor: AI productivity gains could boost growth above baseline
Planning reform and infrastructure investment may lift potential output

factors_down.factor: OBR lowered TFP growth forecast to 0.8%, constraining potential output
Trade policy uncertainty and post-Brexit friction weigh on growth
Ageing population reduces labour force growth
Debt at ~95% GDP constrains fiscal policy response to shocks

key_uncertainties: Whether AI delivers material productivity gains to the UK economy
Whether global trade environment improves or deteriorates

update_triggers.up: Productivity data shows sustained improvement; major trade deals
update_triggers.down: Continued productivity stagnation; trade wars escalate
